name: glu-valve
title: The gate decides how much of each feature passes
sub: The content path xW carries the information, the gate σ(xV) is between 0 (closed) and 1 (open), and GLU multiplies them feature by feature: B and D are nearly blocked.
alt: Three bar charts over four features A to D. Content xW: 2.0, -1.5, 3.0 and 0.5. Gate σ(xV): 0.9, 0.1, 0.95 and 0.05. Output, their product: 1.8, -0.15, 2.85 and 0.025, so the features with a closed gate are blocked.
